publicReleaseNotes: Uptime can read quiet Worker checks stored with a monitor's availability record. These checks appear in history, the overview, reports, the read API, exports and erasure receipts. This release continues writing each check in its own history row, so daily database writes stay at the 0.5.38 level. Migration 0100_quiet_checks.sql adds availability_buckets.checks without rewriting any rows. Rollback to 0.5.38 is safe with the column in place. Once 0.5.40 writes quiet checks, roll back to 0.5.39.
